I need to implement `cappedRunningTotal` in JavaScript. It will compute a running total of the input array, but cap each value at the given limit. Once the cumulative sum reaches or exceeds the cap, all subsequent positions will be set to that cap.

I drafted a loop-based implementation using a `capped` flag, then realized it can be simplified to a single `Math.min(total + num, cap)` expression.
